cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Tell me you understand why six weeks of silence hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. For me, the silence didn't come with a repair notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Can you understand why I kept rewriting a message you'd never answered, trying to become easier to reply to?
